utterances.text: I would exactly like to have those pictures on our screens.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That's good anyhow.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: If we could have page 170 in B/C/S and page 175 in English.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Perhaps we could zoom in slightly on ...

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Overlapping speakers] ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Did you conclude then the basis of these photographs that it was not 5 or 10 centimetres below the edge but it was exactly on the edge?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we have --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Still, I would have one other question. You said this was a wall inside the gym. That's well understood?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This side that is seen on the picture 110, that side of the wall is where the water-pump was. And this other picture, to the right, is the side which is in the gym. If we look up here at these two pictures that are next to one another --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, 110, you say the one is from the one side and the other is from the other side, if I understand you well?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Correct. That's it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Lukic, for you to clarify that, perhaps that -- because the Chamber gains a very initial impression that it may be photographs taken from the same side. But please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Ms. Subotic, concerning these two photographs at the top, it says one is facing the water-pump and the bottom picture says it's the same wall seen from the gym.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: While I was talking, I'm sorry, I was looking at picture 112 where they are juxtaposed, the right picture from 110 and the picture 111 to the left.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Can we have 112 on our screens, please. It's on the next page.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is the juxtaposition pictures 111 and 112 next to each other.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: I think it's 110 and 111.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. 110 and 111 next to each other.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Could we have now 112 on our screen. You said the wall was within the gym. Could you then -- no, I think we should go back by one, one page. Yes. In figure 111, it says the same wall seen from the gym. Now, you said the wall was within the gym. How do I have to understand, then, this picture or is the foreground within the gym? I'm just trying to understand exactly how this -- these pictures were taken.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Photograph 111 was taken from the gym.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. And that shows a wall which is then apparently not in the gym or is it in the gym?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. It's -- it's the wall of the gym.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: So if I say the wall is in the gym, you meant that the wall was -- the wall of the gym. Is that how we have to understand it?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That is how you should understand it. On the other side was the water-pump, behind this wall.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. And that was outside the gym or ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On the sketch of the scene, it is not shown.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Now I'm looking at the surface on 110 and 111. Are you saying that on figure 111 that what we see on the surface before the wall, that's the surface, the ground of the gym.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On figure 110 --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Previous translation continues] ... it's not the floor of the gym and on figure 111, yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. So the flat surface on 110 is outside the gym, and the rather rubbled surface of 111 is the inside of the gym?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Can we have picture 106 now, please. It's in English version 169 and in B/C/S version 167.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Here below the picture it is written that it's the angle of descent according to the investigators --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... depict that --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: 171, my mistake. And in English version, somehow it's not complete.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Below the picture, it says the angle of descent according to the investigators of the Sarajevo police relative to the northerly direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... the next page of this text.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: I understand that that's what that says. I understand it to be what's depicted is something different, I don't know if Mr. Lukic wants to clarify. The angle of descent I understand is something different, possibly, than the direction of fire.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: What do we see on this photograph, Ms. Subotic? Can you explain.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: On this photograph which is different from 105, only in so far as we had indicated the measurements --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... I'm looking at something which is not a photograph but seems to be a sketch with ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm sorry.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. So, therefore, if you can start explaining about the photograph then I'm a bit puzzled what you are referring to. Because the question is what do you see on this picture, which is this sketch, figure 106.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On picture 106, which is the sketch of the site made by the investigators, we see direction north and the direction of the flight of the projectile, and they determined it on the basis of the traces of impact of the projectile on the belt course of the wall where it detonated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Where do we see north exactly -- oh, I see the S. That's the right red line going up. Yes. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Now we would need figure 109. It's 174 in English and 169 in B/C/S.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic, it's still unclear to me what exactly is depicted in the previous one as apparently the wall of impact is the one at the bottom of the sketch. That's -- at least that's what it looks like. Is that correctly understood? What are the other walls or the other structures which we see here?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The sketch of the scene has a legend and, first of all, you are right when you decided to choose this particular point. You can see the stabilizer here on the other side of the wall, mark number 1. Number 2 is the place where the shell detonated, then the direction is --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: The question was what the other structures. I did not invite you to explain at this movement all the markings but, rather, there seems a rectangular structure of which the bottom is the wall that was hit. I'd like to know what the other parts are which are, how do you call it -- yes, it looks like a frame, a rectangular. We know what the bottom is. What is the left side, the right side, and at the top.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is the area where the water pump was.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: But we saw earlier, I think, on the photographs, that the water-pump was at the wall.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Oh no. Oh, no. Not by the wall or in any one of the photographs or, rather -- sorry. It is drawn in the vertical projection so it seems to be by the wall. When we have this vertical projection then we do not see the distance so we just have it in this sense. This projection does not allow us to see the distance. I'm talking about picture 104.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Can we see the water-pump in this sketch? And, if so, where is it located?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The water-pump is marked with the number 3 in this picture.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We're all trying to find it. Give us a second.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On the right-hand side -- on the left-hand side, moving to the right, you have four in the upper part and three in the lower part. Say, 40 per cent of the height viewed from the bottom upwards.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And exactly next to the arc which the -- the large that is correct that was drawn. Yes, we've found it. But still now my question: What are the other structures? Are these walls as well?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] According to the sketch of the scene, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: But is that accurate or is it not accurate, as far as you are concerned?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] As far as I'm concerned, it's correct. The sketch should depict the real situation especially because they made quite an effort here, as far as I can see, to mark everything, truly everything.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: If I could just intervene. In the English version there's two words -- well, there's five words not translated above the two lines. I do believe it might be beneficial to understanding what she's saying if we have these words translated. I understand what they mean but I'm just --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I'm a bit lost. One second please. Oh yes, which seems to read as, and forgive my pronunciation, [B/C/S spoken] pravac leta mine, pravac severa.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Ms. Subotic, this hasn't been translated into English so could you say what it is for the benefit of the English version.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know where it is, where that is, but at any rate.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: On the screen?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: At the beginning of each arrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That's picture 106.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Figure 106, 63 degrees, that trajectory is the trajectory of the flight of the shell according to the Bosnian investigators, whereas pravac severa is direction north and that is again marked by the Bosnian investigators as 320 degrees.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Please proceed. I still do not know what the walls stand for but.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Just for the reference. There is P2043 and there is a legend described on page 15 in both versions, English and B/C/S so ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I'll have a look at it. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Now we should see picture 109. It's on B/C/S page 169 and 174 in English.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Please explain this to us, Ms. Subotic, this photograph or, rather, this sketch and also the city map. What does this show?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In order to see what the actual trajectory of the shell was, we looked at the sketch a moment ago and we placed it on the azimuth of the wall of the gym that is 207 degrees, according to figure 107, and when it is placed that way, then this kind of sketch as drawn by the Bosnian investigators, we clearly see that direction north is wrong, by 50 degrees at that. As they drew it here, the trajectory should be from the west or, rather, 270 degrees. That is what is shown here. That is what this sketch of the scene itself looks like in reality. The trajectory that they marked as 50 degrees is 3, and then direction north is like on any other map.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber, you are on your feet.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honour, it's not clear to me what was the bases that the direction north was wrong.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Well, that may be a question for cross-examination, Mr. Weber. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: At the same time, of course, Mr. Lukic if Mr. Weber doesn't understand it, there is a risk that others wouldn't understand it either, and it's your witness. I certainly would not be discouraged by exploring the matter further.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: So, Ms. Subotic, how did you compare that north from the sketch to this north that you marked as north?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: On Google Earth, we determined the exact direction of the wall of the gym as depicted here in the sketch of the scene. And then we placed that wall on the map, and then had the north been determined correctly, it would have been vertical as north usually is on a map, and as we can see, it is 50 degrees to the left. Of course, we measured that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Are you saying that what we see here, this map is, in fact, Google Earth?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, this is a map of Sarajevo but we measured on Google Earth what it was. First we measured it and placed it there. It's the same on Google Earth, and it's the same on the map of Sarajevo. The north is the same orientation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. I just wanted to clarify that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And I have another question. As we find the school now in Google Earth or, rather, as you found it now, is that exactly oriented in the same way as the school was at the time? Did you verify that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, on the spot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: But on the spot, you couldn't see how it was 20 years ago, can you?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not that but it was restored as it had been. I mean, the gym is oriented the same way and it looks the same way it looked before.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That's exactly what I was trying to find out.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Could we look at the previous figure that showed the north as marked by the investigator and the line of descent of the shell. And before we do that can we note that this rectangle that is on this Google Earth the long side is facing towards the north and the short side -- yeah. It's -- the long side is on the left side and the short side is at the bottom and the top. Can we make a mental note of that. And can we then see the other map.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Could you assist, Mr. Lukic, to give us the right pages and numbers.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. In English, it's page 171 and in B/C/S 167. And that's figure 106.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Now, on this one, it looks to me as if the longer side of the wall is longitudinal instead of almost perpendicular, unlike the one on Google Earth. Am I right or wrong?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Ms. Subotic, on this sketch of the scene, is the entire school depicted or the -- where the pump was? What can you tell us now?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Are we talking about 106?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the room where the pump was and where the incident occurred.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Just a moment, please. This lower wall at the bottom of the sketch, how does it relate to the external wall of the school?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The angle is 207, yes. That is the longitudinal part of the gym but viewed from the other side.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: In order for this to be clearer to us --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: Now we could not hear either one of the speakers at the same time.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I'm just going ask you now what you established finally. Who fired that shell?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: These are two questions, but --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Tell us what did you establish?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We established that the trajectory is shorter than established by the Bosnian investigators on two bases. On the basis of north and the erroneous determination on the basis of what was on the belt course and the wall. So this angle is about 30 degrees, not 63 degrees. We dealt with that in detail here and we established first and foremost that the trajectory is about 230, 240 degrees. And we also came to the conclusion that it was a charge that was probably the basic charge in view of the traces that we found on the spot in terms of the shape of the stabilizer and the deformities on it and we established that most probably. I already said it was 230, 240 degrees and then this is between 300 and 450 metres and the shell is 120.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honours, maybe if we can ask the witness to be more precise in her language. "We found on the spot," and I'm not sure if then she is referring to the file she looked at or her visit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic, are you able to -- I understand Mr. Weber just to get information from what the basis of the answer is rather than to challenge anything at this moment but he may need that in order to prepare for his cross-examination. Could you please clarify the issue.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So, you've heard my colleague Mr. Weber so could you please tell us.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course, we could not material evidence on the spot because we arrived 15 years later or 10 years later but I talked about the evidence from the photo documentation, primarily the stabilizer that in the photo documentation we can find I mean, this document here number 1 and we see typical deformities that are due to the stabilizer being in the blast wave for a longer period of time. That is 120 on the right side. And it is contained in the photo documentation in terms of this sketch and everything else.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Could I -- could you explain what you mean by "deformities that are due to the stabilizer being in the blast wave for a longer period of time." What does that exactly mean?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Actually, this is what it is. If you look at this stabilizer, you see that it was deformed, that it is spreading out. It's not that the fins are deformed. You see here on the left, it's a very good picture. You know, we call this flowering in our professional line of work.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I've got nothing on my screen which shows any tail fin at this moment.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Overlapping speakers] ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 120 on the right-hand side.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Okay. Picture 120.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: It's 177, B/C/S, and 182 in English.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Okay. Could we enlarge especially the right photograph because that's apparently what the witness refers to.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Okay. Now, we now look at this tail fin or stabilizer fine but what I'd like to know to exactly understand what you meant by -- when you said that "these deformities are due to the stabilizer being in the blast wave for a longer period of time." What do you mean exactly by that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I mean the deformity of the central part of the stabilizer. The main one here on the top that was deformed in this way so it looks like the petal of a flower. It was destroyed in that way. This can only happen in one way, this way.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. But you still have not answered my question.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm sorry, I thought I did. Let's try to do it again?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: What does it mean that the stabilizer has been in the blast wave for a longer period of time. First of all, what exactly is the blast wave?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] A blast wave occurs after an explosion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is the product of combustion and that moves at a certain speed. That's what I'm talking about. High temperatures and so on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Now, it has been the blast wave for a longer period of time. Longer than what? I mean, what's the difference between in the blast wave for a short period of time or a long period of time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] After any explosion a blast wave continues and that is not what we are discussing now. We are discussing the following, that the position of the flight of the shell was such that when the stabilizer left, it went in the direction of the trajectory. And since the descent angle was big, it spent a lot of time in these gases that are very fast and very hot, and that is how this phenomenon occurred. In professional terms, we call that flowering.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I see that and how is that different if the trajectory is - let me see - is a short one? When is it short, when is it longer?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It spends less time when the angles of descent are smaller. When they're not like this one, which was probably almost 80 degrees.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I still do not -- I do understand that a shell explodes and that creates a blast wave, which affects the fin, which is at the end of the explosion. What I do not yet understand is why at a steeper angle of descent compared to a less steep angle of descent, what the difference is in the time the tail-fin is in that blast wave? I just don't understand that yet. If could you explain that to me, I would appreciate.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The stabilizer spend ascertain amount of time that is not defined and it depends on the speed on the charge and the angle of descent. In this case, the only possibility was, it is so concluded, that it arrived at a very large angle of descent so it remained there and it was basically thrown vertically upwards and that is the only way in which this deformation could take place. It depends on the speed and we've already seen examples --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Earlier you said it depends on the angle of descent, and you said it was the deformation. Now you are introducing new elements, that is, where it is found, which is, for me, the same as deformation. And you also now, the charge and the -- what did you say? - the speed of the charge is included as well.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] My understanding was that you had asked me what determines this position of the stabilizer in relation to the time that it spends in this blast wave so that is why I gave a more complex answer. In this case, we concluded that the only possible way of having such a deformity is that the projectile arrived at a very big angle of descent, so then after it was thrown, it continued his trajectory vertically upwards and in this way, spent enough time there in order to have this kind of product in the blast wave. And then, of course, when it reached a certain height, it fell where it fell, where it was found, where they found it, rather, the Bosnian investigators, on the other side of the wall.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I -- I -- I hear a new explanation. That is, that the time in which the tail-fin spent during flight is what you said was the time it was in the blast wave. Is that well understood?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Earlier you told us that the blast wave was created by the explosion, which is after the trajectory of the projectile has ended and exploded upon impact. I have difficulties in reconciling the two answers, but if you could explain, please do; otherwise, we'll move on.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't see that -- I don't see anything that is contrary in the two answers. If you tell me explicitly what it is that is unclear, I will be glad to answer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. We'll move on. Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Just for the record, Your Honour, on page 61, line 4, I was just informed that interpreters could not hear any of us, either me or Ms. Subotic, and there, I asked whether the wall that we saw on figure 106 in which position comparing to the outer wall, the lower wall on the bottom of this sketch. And Ms. Subotic replied on that. I can ask again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I think Mr. Weber would highly appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: So, Ms. Subotic, could we -- should we go back or do you know it? Picture 106, that wall, at the bottom, how is it relative to the outside wall?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It has the same azimuth as the outside part of the gym. 207 degrees.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic, we're close to the time where we take another break, so if you could finish within two minutes from now and then we'll take a break.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You gave an answer but I don't think it was clear. You mentioned 300 to 450 metres.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: What did you mean to say and what does that indicate, from which positions could it have been fired?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It shows it was fired from BH army positions. I said the angle was 237, and there's 300 to 450 metres distance to the location of fire, and the calibre of the shell was 120 millimetres and that was never in dispute.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... good time for me to have a break.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We take a break. The witness may follow the usher. We resume at quarter to 2.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Before we continue, Mr. Lukic, I would have one question. We earlier talked about the measurements. You remember the 320 metres, the height of the wall, and the 575, which was the hypotenuse of the equation. Could you tell us -- you said that it's wrong. How much is it wrong?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It seems to me it's 30, 35 per cent error relative to the basic measure. We did not make our conclusions based on these erroneous results.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: 35 per cent, you're saying? Could you make that calculation for us and come back. That is, the 4.70 as one of the legs; the 3.20 for the other leg; and would you then also calculate what would be the result if the 3 metre 20s, would, slightly off, well, let's say 3 metre, 10. Could you then tell us if you could please do that and come back tomorrow to us to tell us whether the difference is 35 per cent --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Certainly. Although I think we've provided it. But let's not waste any more time now I'll prepare it for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That is, 320 or 310 vertically; 470 horizontally. And then you tell us what in these two options the hypotenuse would be how much percentage it differs from the 5.75 that is indicated on the map [Overlapping speakers] ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Overlapping speakers] ... I will it for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ...

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So we already have on the screen, 1D5498. Could we see page 184 in English and 179 in B/C/S. It's the shelling incident in Livanjska Street, 8 November 1994. It's not in the indictment. The Prosecution presented evidence in this case, such as the official report of the police, P621, then P860, and P855, which is the statement of Mr. Sabljica. This part of your report begins here.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We need picture 124 which, in English, is on page 188, and in B/C/S, it's page 183.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Just as a reference, this photograph was taken from a video, which is 65 ter 1D05920, and when you look at the film, you almost can't see this because there are only three frames at 4 minutes, 24 seconds. Ms. Subotic, we will not play this movie now because it's very hard to see this fraction of a second, but this is a still from that video.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we get that picture back on the screen [Previous translation continues] ... 1D5498. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Would you tell us, Ms. Subotic, what is characteristic in this incident.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: First of all, this incident was interesting because the inspector who made the on-site investigation gave no access to UNPROFOR. The UNPROFOR reacted, and then the Presidency of Bosnia-Herzegovina ordered that the investigation be repeated the next day, which was unusual.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we now see on the screens -- and we should like to tender that video. That's 1D52 -- sorry. That's 1D05920.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honour, we have no objection to the admission of it, but we would like to view it if we could possibly do it overnight just to make sure what's being tendered and what clip is a part of it. I would also note for the -- there's two shellings involved here. And for the first shelling, not all the investigative materials are admitted, so I can also discuss that with Mr. Lukic and probably report back in the morning and see what can be tendered in all with respect to the incident.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Lukic, I take it that you are agreeable to further discuss the matter with Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Please proceed, meanwhile. Perhaps we MFI it for the time being. Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document 1D05920 receives exhibit number D1261.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And is marked for identification. But I think we have some problem with the ... yes, please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we have on our screens now 1D01337, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We see a document from UNPROFOR dated 5 November -- 9 November 1994 relating to this incident.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we look at page 9 in English because it's a sketch.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Do you know what this picture shows?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: On this map with markings, we see possible ranges, directions and possible distances depending on charge. And, of course, we see the separation line, but I can say immediately that based on material evidence, this was done for the shell M74, 82-millimetres and on the ground, tail-fins were found from the shell that was M681, 82 millimetres. French investigators did this after discussion with Bosnian investigators because they stated that the shell had been fired from the Bosnian side and there was a serious discussion about the fact that UNPROFOR investigators used wrong tables and they were told that in the Yugoslav army there was no 82-millimetre shell with that charge, which is incorrect. That shell is M681, and it's on the same firing tables as shell M74.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Can you mark on this map the separation line?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Before we do so, your answer reads: "French investigators did this after discussion with Bosnian investigators because they stated," who stated? Did the French investigators state that the shell had been fired from [Overlapping speakers] ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Bosnian investigators complained to the French investigators that they had used wrong firing tables, and we have no shells with four charges, which is not true. And after this agreement with the Bosnian investigators, the French investigators made this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: The only thing I'm do something try to find out is to whom you refer when you say "they." Do I understand that the French claimed that or was it the Bosnian themselves that claimed that the shell was fired from the Bosnian-held territory? Is that what you are telling us?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] French investigators claimed that the shell had been fired from Bosnian territory, and CSB investigators objected.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... that answers my question. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honours, I believe that there was going to be a marking on the image on the screen. I just would ask maybe we rotate it to the way we're usually used to seeing Sarajevo which I believe would be 90 degrees counterclockwise, if I'm correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: If it we look at it, then we'll see. Because it's not extremely clear. But could we turn it counterclockwise for 90 degrees. Is this --

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: I would have been wrong. We need to rotate. It's the other way. Sorry about that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Could we now move it 180 degrees in whatever direction. Okay. There we are. Let's have a look at it. Yes, please proceed, Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. I would need help from usher.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could you please mark the separation line.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Where are the Serb positions within these lines? Can you mark them.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Serb positions are to the right of this upper line.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: So the distance marked here is 4350. You see it at the top. What charge would it correspond to?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That depends which of these two shells we're talking about, but I have to say immediately the investigators determined it was 0 plus 3, that is to say, the third charge and they determined the distance of 2475 metres. I can check.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Could you, apart from telling us the conclusion [Overlapping speakers] ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Overlapping speakers] ... yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Apart from it being a 0 plus 3 charge, how they defined it was a 0 plus 3 charge.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Of course, they did not explain it in any way. They just put it on the sketch where they determined angle of descent. They wrote 0 plus 3. They provided that range and if they hadn't provided the range we wouldn't even know which shell they were analysing. But then we determined it was -- they said it was M74, 82 millimetres.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Please proceed, Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. And in the same document, we need page 3 in both versions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Do you tender this marked --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber. Madam Registrar, the map marked additionally by this witnesses in blue.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Will receive exhibit number D1262, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Admitted into evidence. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: But we should perhaps state for the record that the five short lines were put by the witness indicating Serb positions.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. So now we need page 3 in both versions so we have both B/C/S and English on the screen. And it's 1D1337.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Did you make any measurements or investigations of this incident?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We certainly investigated based on the documentation the photo documentation and other technical data that was recorded using, of course, all the statements in order to arrive at the conclusion as to from where, which type of projectile, from where it was fired, and the most probable angle of descent, as well as from which direction. The illustration, the depiction of our investigation is shown on picture 34 [as interpreted].

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Could you just check the number of the picture? We have 34 on the record.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's picture 134, a sketch made on the map, and it illustrates in which position for the determined azimuth where separation lines and the ranges discussed by Bosnian investigators relative to the location of the incident.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: What was found on that occasion? Did the stabiliser embed itself?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it did. And according to the document which is now before us, the crater was 3 centimetre deep. It was partially embedded and that was probably the reason why Bosnian investigators wrote that it was 0 plus 3.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: At this time, it's getting confusing as to which of the shellings we're referring to. There's two shellings that happened two hours apart in this event and I'm not really clear on the embedding and which one -- which shelling she's saying it's a part of.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I was referring to ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. ... Yes, please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Just so that I would not answer the question, Ms. Subotic, what is shown in your sketch, your picture 134, was that the shelling at 1525 or the shelling at 1730?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's about 1535 in Livanjska Street, number 26.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: If we looked at the previous sketch from the French document, what was the charge? What was the charge that it could be fired with from Serbian positions?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As far as I remember that sketch, the only possible charge would be six.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honour, again, it's not clear to me. It wasn't established what the last document, what shelling. Was that the earlier or later shelling.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: When you referred to the sketch and the only possible charge, which of the two shells did you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I meant the sketch that I marked a moment ago made by the French investigators, and it was admitted into evidence, if I understood well. I thought that was what I was asked about.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That document, as far as I remember, doesn't refer to which of the two shells it was. The report that our attention is drawn to talks about shell number one and shell number two. What I'd like to know is whether you had on your mind still number one, because I think that's what you earlier referred to, and -- or whether it's the second one.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, all this time we have been discussing only the first shell.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That's the one with the 3 centimetres -- 3 centimetres, what is it called again, the depth of the crater.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Depth of the crater, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Please -- I would be inclined to say please proceed, but, Mr. Lukic, I'm looking at the clock. Please do not proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I need one more question and then we can move to Markale tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That's fine.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: In this document that was uploaded obviously after I had underlined something, using the yellow colour, the French came to the conclusion that perhaps the most suspicious zone was under -- the most suspected area was under the control of the BiH. What is your understanding of this and do you agree?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I agree and we reached that conclusion as well, after our analysis.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... tender this 1D01337.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honour, our records indicate that a copy of this document has already been admitted under D185, if counsel could please check.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I will. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Okay. We'll deal with it first thing if whether or not you again what may be the same document. Ms. Subotic, we'll adjourn for the day. We'd like to see you back tomorrow morning at 9.30, and I again instruct you that you should not speak or communicate in whatever way with whomever it is about your testimony, whether already given or still to be given. And you may now follow the usher. No -- no loud speaking, Mr. Mladic.

utterances.text: We adjourn for the day, and we'll resume tomorrow, Tuesday, the 29th of September, 9.30 in the morning in this same courtroom 1. Oh, 10.00 in the morning.
